title: Sean McVay on Puka Nacua's future with Rams: 'Can't say for certain anything'

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: Sean McVay on Puka Nacua's future with Rams: 'Can't say for certain anything'
sources.description: Sean McVay believes Rams star Puka Nacua will remain with the team, but he also knows the Rams will have other free agents they'll need to sign.
